decisions.model: request-to-book only: traveller requests a date, the owning creator accepts or declines, traveller may withdraw before a decision
decisions.money: no payment fields, no amounts, no provider; nothing is charged or confirmed
decisions.contact: the product does not collect contact details; both panels tell the traveller to include a way to be reached in the message if a follow-up is wanted
decisions.rateLimit: 5 requests per traveller per rolling 24 hours, enforced in the database
